value.definition: the shape of a folder a page above claims, holding no page and no page's file

invariants.statement: A page above claims this folder by a folder property.
A folder under a claimed folder is claimed too.
A folder no page above claims is refused.
A folder holding a page is refused.
A folder holding a file some page names is refused.
A folder holding neither a file nor a folder is refused.
What the files here hold is not read.

value.definition: the shape of a folder with one domain, its modules and the parts it declares

invariants.statement: The folder has one page.
That page is a page of a type at or beneath domain.
A page type is beneath domain and has a shape of its own, so it is refused here.
No folder takes this shape and that one at once.
The folder takes the name that page gives its folder.
A second page in the folder is one the folder answers for beside the domain.
Every other file in the folder is a part one of those two pages states.
The folder every other folder in the workspace sits under takes this shape.
That folder takes the name of the checkout rather than the name its domain gives.
A subfolder named `modules` is a part of that page.
A subfolder named `scripts` is a part of that page.
A subfolder with a page the domain declares a part is a part too.
A subfolder with no page the domain declares is refused.
A subfolder with a second page that is no domain of the first is no part.
A subfolder a file this page's own property names sits under is a part of that page.
A subfolder this page's own folder property names is a part of that page.

value.definition: the shape of a folder with one page type, its parts and the pages and properties it declares

invariants.statement: The folder has one page.
That page is a page type.
The folder may have a second page beside that page type.
That second page is a domain of the page type's slug.
Any other second page is refused.
The page type names the folder.
That second page names no folder.
The folder has the name that page calls its folder.
Every other file in the folder is a part the page states.
A file that second page states is a part of the folder too.
A subfolder named `modules` is a part of that page.
A subfolder named `pages` is a part of that page.
A subfolder named `properties` is a part of that page.
A subfolder named `scripts` is a part of that page.
A subfolder with a page the page type declares a part is a part too.
A subfolder with a page that second page declares a part is a part too.
A subfolder with no page the page type declares is refused.
A subfolder with a second page that is no domain of the first is no part.
A subfolder named `workstation-services` is a part of that page.
A subfolder a file this page's own property names sits under is a part of that page.

value.definition: the shape of a folder named for the one page it has, beside that page's parts

invariants.statement: The folder has one page.
That page is of a type that is no domain, since a domain has a shape of its own.
No folder takes this shape and that one at once.
The folder's name is the name that page gives its folder.
Every other file in the folder is a part the page states.
Which files are parts is read off the file properties the page states.
A part whose name the property page states is a part under that name.
The secrets and the uncommitted values held beside the page are parts of the page.
A subfolder named `modules` is a part of that page.
A subfolder named `pages` is a part of that page.
A subfolder named `properties` is a part of that page.
A subfolder named `sections` is a part of that page.
`sections-of-the-book-above` judges a subfolder named `sections`.
A subfolder named anything else is no part of that page.
The paths a part has are judged where that part is judged.
A folder with no page is refused.
A folder holding more than one page is refused.

value.definition: the shape of a folder named service-workstations with one service with its parts

invariants.statement: The folder is named `service-workstations`.
The folder has one page.
That page is of the `service-workstation` page type.
Every other file in the folder is a part of that page.
A folder with a subfolder is refused.

value.definition: the shape of a folder with the module folders the page above it declares

invariants.statement: The folder is named `modules` or `.server`.
React Router runs a file under `.server` on the server and never in a browser.
No page claims that name.
Each module has a folder to itself.
A folder with any file of its own is refused.
Every subfolder has a module.
Every module in that folder is a part the page above declares.
A folder above holding no page is asked for no part.
The files a module holds are judged where that module is judged.
A subfolder holding a second page is the folder of no module.

value.definition: the shape of a folder named pages with the pages of the page type above it

invariants.statement: The folder is named `pages`.
The folder above has one page type.
That page type says which pages belong here.
A page sitting in the folder is of that page type.
The folder has page files alone or page folders alone.
The folder has no file beside a page file.
A file held uncommitted beside a page is no file beside that page here.
Each subfolder has one page of that page type or one page that page type declares a part.
Anything else a subfolder holds is judged where that subfolder is judged.
A folder named `pages` above which no page type sits is refused.
A file that is neither a page nor a file beside a page is refused.

value.definition: the shape of a folder named properties with the properties the page type above it declares

invariants.statement: The folder is named `properties`.
The folder above has one page type and that page type declares the properties belonging here.
A page is a property where `page-property` is anywhere above its page type.
A page's slug is a property slug that page type declares.
A file beside a property page is a file that property page states.
A field declared by a property page beside a property page is declared by that page type too.
A folder named `properties` above which no page type sits is refused.
A file that is neither a page nor a file beside a page is refused.

value.definition: the shape of a folder with property pages and nothing else

invariants.statement: The folder is named `properties`.
The name is judged before the files the folder has are judged.
A folder with no file of its own takes the shape under that name.
A page is a property where `page-property` is anywhere above its page type.
The pages here are of several types and that mix is the shape rather than a fault in that shape.
Which page the pages here are properties of is not judged here.
The folder above says which page these pages are properties of.
A file beside a property page is a file that property page states.
A file that is neither a page nor a file beside a page is refused.

value.definition: the shape of a folder named scripts with a folder for each script and nothing else

invariants.statement: The folder is named `scripts`.
Each script has a folder to itself.
A folder with any file of its own is refused.
Every subfolder has a page of the `shell-script` page type.
A subfolder with any other page is refused.
A subfolder with no page is refused too.
A script the page above declares nowhere is refused by nothing here.
The other files a script's own folder holds are judged where that folder is judged.

value.definition: the shape of a folder named sections with the sections of the book above it

invariants.statement: The folder is named `sections`.
The folder above has one book Alan writes.
Every page in the folder is a book section.
Every section in the folder names the book above as the collection holding that section.
A section names the book above by that book's page type and slug together.
A section has its prose in a file beside the section rather than in a folder.
A folder inside has the sections one section of this book is made of.
The folder has no file that is neither a section nor a file beside a section.
A folder named `sections` with no section is refused.
A folder inside is judged by the shape for the sections of a section.

value.definition: the shape of a folder with the sections of the section sitting beside it

invariants.statement: The folder is named for a section sitting beside the folder.
A book Alan writes is somewhere above the folder.
Every folder between is looked through to find that book.
Every page in the folder is a book section.
Every section in the folder names the section the folder is named for.
That name is an address of the page type and then the book and then the section.
A section has its prose in a file beside the section rather than in a folder.
The folder has no file that is neither a section nor a file beside a section.
A folder named for a section with no section is refused.
A folder inside has the sections one section of this book is made of.

value.definition: the shape of a folder with the test fixture folders the page above it declares

invariants.statement: The folder is named `test-fixtures`.
No page claims that name.
Each test fixture has a folder to itself.
A folder with any file of its own is refused.
Every subfolder has a test fixture.
Every test fixture in that folder is a part the page above declares.
A folder above holding no page is asked for no part.
The files a test fixture holds are judged where that test fixture is judged.
A subfolder holding a second page is the folder of no test fixture.
